card.title: Don’t Break the Routine
card.instruction: Protect a familiar routine as though changing one step would invite chaos into everything else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Curtains, cat food, then our breakfast. Why's his bowl already down?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He woke me early. I fed him so you could sleep.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before the curtains? Now he'll expect every meal before the day starts.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll open them now. Your toast is ready too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep it warm. We need him back at the bowl before we can safely have breakfast.
